SELECT 
    TRIM(SEC_SNAME) AS `股票名称`,
    STOCKCODE AS `股票代码`,
    '2026-01-01' AS `区间起始日期`,
    '2026-09-02' AS `区间截止日期`,
    CAST(TCLOSE AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS `期末收盘价`,
    CAST((
        SELECT TCLOSE
        FROM VIEW_STK_STI_MKT t_start
        WHERE t_start.STOCKCODE = t_end.STOCKCODE
            AND t_start.TRADE_DATE = (SELECT MIN(TRD.TRADE_DATE) 
                                      FROM VIEW_STK_STI_MKT TRD
                                      WHERE TRD.TRADE_DATE >= '2026-01-01' AND TRD.TRADE_DATE <= '2026-09-02'
                                        AND TRD.STOCKCODE = t_end.STOCKCODE
                                        AND TRD.TCLOSE IS NOT NULL)
            AND t_start.TRADE_DATE >= '2026-01-01'
            AND t_start.TRADE_DATE <= '2026-09-02'
            AND t_start.TCLOSE IS NOT NULL
        LIMIT 1
    ) AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS `区间起始收盘价`,
    CASE 
        WHEN (
            SELECT TCLOSE
            FROM VIEW_STK_STI_MKT t_start
            WHERE t_start.STOCKCODE = t_end.STOCKCODE
                AND t_start.TRADE_DATE = (SELECT MIN(TRD.TRADE_DATE) 
                                          FROM VIEW_STK_STI_MKT TRD
                                          WHERE TRD.TRADE_DATE >= '2026-01-01' AND TRD.TRADE_DATE <= '2026-09-02'
                                            AND TRD.STOCKCODE = t_end.STOCKCODE
                                            AND TRD.TCLOSE IS NOT NULL)
                AND t_start.TRADE_DATE >= '2026-01-01'
                AND t_start.TRADE_DATE <= '2026-09-02'
                AND t_start.TCLOSE IS NOT NULL
            LIMIT 1
        ) IS NOT NULL AND 
        (
            SELECT TCLOSE
            FROM VIEW_STK_STI_MKT t_start
            WHERE t_start.STOCKCODE = t_end.STOCKCODE
                AND t_start.TRADE_DATE = (SELECT MIN(TRD.TRADE_DATE) 
                                          FROM VIEW_STK_STI_MKT TRD
                                          WHERE TRD.TRADE_DATE >= '2026-01-01' AND TRD.TRADE_DATE <= '2026-09-02'
                                            AND TRD.STOCKCODE = t_end.STOCKCODE
                                            AND TRD.TCLOSE IS NOT NULL)
                AND t_start.TRADE_DATE >= '2026-01-01'
                AND t_start.TRADE_DATE <= '2026-09-02'
                AND t_start.TCLOSE IS NOT NULL
            LIMIT 1
        ) != 0
        THEN
            ROUND((TCLOSE - (
                SELECT TCLOSE
                FROM VIEW_STK_STI_MKT t_start
                WHERE t_start.STOCKCODE = t_end.STOCKCODE
                    AND t_start.TRADE_DATE = (SELECT MIN(TRD.TRADE_DATE) 
                                              FROM VIEW_STK_STI_MKT TRD
                                              WHERE TRD.TRADE_DATE >= '2026-01-01' AND TRD.TRADE_DATE <= '2026-09-02'
                                                AND TRD.STOCKCODE = t_end.STOCKCODE
                                                AND TRD.TCLOSE IS NOT NULL)
                    AND t_start.TRADE_DATE >= '2026-01-01'
                    AND t_start.TRADE_DATE <= '2026-09-02'
                    AND t_start.TCLOSE IS NOT NULL
                LIMIT 1
            )) / (
                SELECT TCLOSE
                FROM VIEW_STK_STI_MKT t_start
                WHERE t_start.STOCKCODE = t_end.STOCKCODE
                    AND t_start.TRADE_DATE = (SELECT MIN(TRD.TRADE_DATE) 
                                              FROM VIEW_STK_STI_MKT TRD
                                              WHERE TRD.TRADE_DATE >= '2026-01-01' AND TRD.TRADE_DATE <= '2026-09-02'
                                                AND TRD.STOCKCODE = t_end.STOCKCODE
                                                AND TRD.TCLOSE IS NOT NULL)
                    AND t_start.TRADE_DATE >= '2026-01-01'
                    AND t_start.TRADE_DATE <= '2026-09-02'
                    AND t_start.TCLOSE IS NOT NULL
                LIMIT 1
            ) * 100, 2)
        ELSE NULL 
    END AS `今年以来累计涨跌幅(%)`
FROM 
    VIEW_STK_STI_MKT t_end
WHERE 
    TRADE_DATE = '2026-09-02'
    AND TCLOSE IS NOT NULL
    AND SEC_SNAME IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY
    `今年以来累计涨跌幅(%)` DESC
